name: Resistor Environment QA 4
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Flow of current through ammeter in parallel resistor circuit

examples.input: Five identical lamps each of resistance \SI{1100}{\ohm} are connected in parallel to a 220V supply. Ammeter is not placed to measure the total current from the supply. Instead, it is positioned in the main branch after the first two lamps and before the last three lamps split off. What is the current through the ammeter?
